_meta: G7 fragment (owner: SQUAD7). Squad tactics, formations and convoy tunables read by sim/systems/formations7.gd (Formations7.cfg). Every value is PROVISIONAL (set by SQUAD7 where the plan did not settle it). Scale ~7 m per tile: foot_sp 1.1 tiles ~8 m; staggered column nearest neighbour ~9 m foot, veh_col_sp 7.5 tiles ~52 m vehicles; veh_sp 3.5 tiles ~25 m in combat shapes. default_player_formation = shape for player group moves without a chosen formation: auto picks wedge / staggered column (road, short column) / file (close terrain) by terrain and threat (Formations7.auto_form), a formation name forces it, an empty string keeps the G1 grid; auto_col_len = longest auto column in tiles. gait_mult = speed factor for walk, crouch-walk, duck-run, sprint (WOUND7 folds it into e.mvm). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
